verdict.rationale: Blaxel has an official CLI with a documented CLI reference. API keys authenticate the CLI, and an official GitHub Action wires the CLI into CI pipelines, so the core of the story is delivered. The evidence does not show the CLI's command coverage or any agent-oriented ergonomics; the agent 'skill' is a separate capability. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of CLI command scope (deploy/sandbox/jobs), AI-native CLI features such as machine-readable output or agent-driven use, independent or hands-on corroboration.
